summary: Independent EvidenceGate re-review approves TASK-0045 after the digest correction. This approval is limited to the closeout/no-go evidence package and to TASK-0044 timeout recovery audit correctness under live Mode C conditions. It does not approve Mode C default-path promotion. The corrected verification summary hashes now match current file bytes and manifest SHA values; three isolated Mode C runs still have success_count=0 with timeout:3, all stateful timeouts recovered to terminal failed GoalExecution/PlanExecution state, independent goal inspect evidence is clean, unavailable provider token/cost usage remains null, and Mode C remains no-go for the default path.

criteria.criterion: TASK-0043 and TASK-0044 are completed by EvidenceGate and Mode C remains non-default.
criteria.notes: TASK-0043 and TASK-0044 are completed by prior EvidenceGate approvals, and TASK-0045 decision evidence keeps Mode C non-default/no-go.

criteria.criterion: Mode C is run only with explicit `--allow-combined` and `--allow-model-cost`.
Three bounded isolated Mode C repetitions are executed, or a provider/setup blocker is classified without weakening criteria.
criteria.notes: Scorecard records three bounded isolated Mode C repetitions: run_count=3, success_count=0, failure_classes={timeout:3}.

criteria.criterion: Every run with durable GoalExecution state has independent `goal inspect --artifact-dir` evidence with zero missing artifacts and no artifact findings, or any exception is explicitly classified.
criteria.notes: All three independent goal inspect outputs report missingArtifactCount=0 and artifactFindings=[]; the summary reports all_inspects_clean=true.

criteria.criterion: Stateful isolated timeouts are recovered through TASK-0044 behavior: no synthetic skipped `runner_timeout` result is published when request and SQLite state exist.
criteria.notes: All three stateful isolated timeouts have recoveryAttempted=true and recoveredPartialRun=true; no synthetic skipped runner_timeout result is used for runs with request and SQLite state.

criteria.criterion: No recovered timeout leaves GoalExecution running while its active PlanExecution is terminal.
criteria.notes: All recovered runs have terminal failed GoalExecution and PlanExecution state with active_plan_execution_ref=null; no running goal with terminal plan remains.

criteria.criterion: Every real Planner output is admitted or rejected before any Executor side effect.
criteria.notes: Each real Planner output was accepted by Planner admission before Executor side effects were observed.

criteria.criterion: Every observed Executor side effect is capability-admitted and auditable before execution.
criteria.notes: Observed bounded_task side effects have admission decision refs and capability grant refs; capability_admission_coverage=1.0.

criteria.criterion: Hard safety counters remain zero for false completion, unrun gate pass, unadmitted node execution, stale fencing accept and duplicate resume effect.
criteria.notes: False completion, unrun gate pass, stale fencing accept, and duplicate resume effect counters are zero; no unadmitted observed side effect was found. Corrected digest audit now passes.

criteria.criterion: Provider token/cost usage is recorded per run when available; unavailable usage remains null, not fabricated.
criteria.notes: Provider usage is recorded per run as unavailable with input/output/total token and cost fields null; no fabricated 0.0 cost/token values are used.

criteria.criterion: The final decision distinguishes timeout/audit correctness from combined model/runtime quality and gives a clear go/no-go recommendation.
criteria.notes: Final decision separates timeout recovery audit correctness from combined model/runtime quality and recommends no-go for Mode C default path.

criteria.criterion: Producer moves task only to review; EvidenceGate decides completion.
criteria.notes: Producer returned the task to review after correction; this independent EvidenceGate evaluation is the completion authority.
